info.headline: Biddupur: flooding expected, move to a shelter before 20:00
info.description: About 16,654 people and 2013 buildings in Biddupur are in the area expected to take water. Typical depth 1.4 m, up to 6.9 m in the lowest parts.
info.instruction: Move to Keshav Vidya Mandir before 20:00 today. Alternate road for Izra/ Salimabad may stop taking cars after 22:00. If you cannot leave, move to an upper floor and call 1070.
